description:
Two-Bedroom Semi-Detached Home with No Onward Chain

Presenting this delightful two-bedroom semi-detached home, offering well-proportioned accommodation ideal for first-time buyers, downsizers, or investors alike.

The property features a spacious and welcoming living room, perfect for relaxing or entertaining, alongside a generous dining kitchen that provides ample space for family meals and social gatherings. To the first floor, there are two comfortable bedrooms and a family bathroom.

Externally, the home enjoys gardens to both the front and rear, creating pleasant outdoor spaces to enjoy throughout the year. A driveway provides ample off-road parking for multiple vehicles.

Offered to the market with no onward chain, this attractive home is situated within a thriving and well-connected neighbourhood, benefiting from easy access to local amenities, well-regarded schools, and excellent transport links.

Directions From Scotland Road turn off onto Beechwood Avenue then take first left onto Lansdowne Crescent. Continue along the road, number 128 is in a cul-de-sac on the right-hand side.

Services Mains gas, electric, water and drains are connected, but neither these services nor any boilers or radiators have been tested.

Key Information: • Standard construction. • We understand that broadband and mobile telephone reception are available. For an indication of speeds and supply please see the OFCOM website: • There is private off road vehicle parking.
